verdict.rationale: Proton Pass generates TOTP codes inside saved login items, so its own vaults and its 'Folders and subfolders' feature also organize those codes. However, the evidence never shows search, service icons, or a quick two-tap path to a code. One hands-on user also found the extension's unexpandable pop-up inadequate for managing hundreds of logins. Missing for 10: documented search, service icons/favicons for entries, evidence of quick two-tap code access, folder feature details beyond a pricing-page line, independent corroboration of organizing many tokens.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away

citations.quote: Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
